description: Change one line item on a job: its name, description, kind, quantity, price or cost. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. Prices in DOLLARS - this server converts to Housecall Pro's integer cents for you. Housecall Pro requires the name on every update to this route, so pass it even when only a price is changing; an update without it is rejected. A job's line-item list also carries rows Housecall Pro added itself, an automatic tax line among them, so check what a row is before touching it rather than working through the whole list. Changing a line item changes the job's total and its derived description. Nothing is sent to the customer by itself, though a customer who opens an invoice they were already sent sees the new figure.

line_item_id.description: Line item id (rli_...), from the hcp_add_job_line_items response or the job record

name.description: Required by Housecall Pro on every update, even when it is not changing

unit_cost_dollars.description: Your cost per unit in dollars
